items.title: Syrma SGS Q4 Results: Net profit surges 67% to ₹119 crore, driven by strong revenue growth
items.description: Syrma SGS Technology Ltd experienced an impressive financial year, reporting a remarkable 87% increase in net profit, reaching Rs 345.8 crore. The company's revenue saw substantial growth as well, with export revenue exceeding Rs 1,200 crore.

items.title: TVS Motor Q4 Results: Cons PAT grows 19% YoY to Rs 772 crore as revenue jumps 30%
items.description: TVS Motor Q4 Results: The company posted a revenue growth of 30% to Rs 15,053 crore in Q4FY26 versus Rs 11,542 crore in the corresponding quarter of the previous financial year.

items.title: HPCL Q4 Results: Net profit jumps 46% YoY to Rs 4,902 crore; Rs 19.25/sh dividend declared
items.description: Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited (HPCL) reported a significant 46% surge in consolidated net profit to Rs 4,902 crore for the fourth quarter of FY26. The oil marketing giant also announced a final dividend of Rs 19.25 per share.  Standalone total income saw a 4.5% year-on-year increase to Rs 1.24 lakh crore during the same period.

items.title: Ventive Hospitality Q4 profit climbs 72% to Rs 259 crore, revenue up 21%
items.description: Ventive Hospitality Ltd announced strong financial results for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2026. Net profit surged 72% in the fourth quarter and full-year profit reached Rs 502 crore. Revenue also saw substantial increases. The company's hotel sector and annuity portfolio performed well. Strategic acquisitions were also completed during the period, positioning Ventive for future growth.

items.title: PFC Q4 Results: Profit rises 24% to Rs 6,325 crore as interest income grows
items.description: Power Finance Corp reported a strong rise in fourth-quarter and full-year earnings for FY26, supported by higher interest income, improved fee income and a reversal in impairment provisions. Lower credit costs and steady growth in core lending operations helped the state-run power sector financier deliver improved profitability despite higher finance costs.
